pre_committed_rule: PASS = holdout Sharpe (2025-01-01 → 2026-06-30, daily returns, mean/std·√252, computed from the strategy equity curve) > 0.600. Anything else = FAIL.

holdout.note_on_start: Equity curve begins 2025-01-31 (first month-end rebalance in the 2025-01-01 → 2026-06-30 window); scores trade forward, so daily returns exist only from 2025-02-03 onward.

informational.vs_test_sharpe_0990: Holdout Sharpe 1.016 vs 2023-24 test Sharpe 0.990 (+0.03) and Sprint 0 test 0.783 (+0.23) — the 2025-26 window did not degrade risk-adjusted performance despite an 18-month gap past the last training fold.
informational.vs_spy_sharpe: Strategy Sharpe 1.016 vs SPY 1.007 (Δ +0.009) — Sharpe advantage is thin; absolute-return excess is +23.1 percentage points (strategy +49.3% vs SPY +26.2%).
informational.breadth_vs_production_mean_246: Holdout breadth mean 14.9 is materially below the 24.6 in-sample mean; only 5 of 18 months hit the 20-name target. The strategy ran under-diversified on most months, which likely drove both the wide monthly return dispersion and the -27% max drawdown.
informational.regime_note: 82% of the holdout was RISK_ON (1.2× leverage). This amplifies both the +49% return and the -27% drawdown; a more RISK_OFF regime would have produced different absolute numbers.
informational.monthly_result_note: Result is bimodal: seven months of >±3% excess (five negative, four positive after signing corrections in 2025-08 and 2026-05). May 2026's +23.4-pt excess alone drives ~half of the total-return gap vs SPY — the verdict is sensitive to whether that single month held or not.
informational.timesfm_caveat: The TimesFM 1M return forecast is one of the 23 features. TimesFM's pretrained checkpoint has an unknown data-vintage cutoff and may already have seen macro/price patterns from the 2025 calendar year; treat 2025 rows of `timesfm_pred_return_1m` as a possible subtle-leak channel. Not remediable in this sprint — flag only.
informational.march_2026_tie_note: 2026-03-31 breadth of 53 is genuine LightGBM leaf saturation, not a data collapse. Feature vectors were verified distinct (53/53 unique) with 30 distinct predicted probabilities in [0.539, 0.622]; five names tied at the top-leaf value 0.622146. Top-N holdings for that month were tie-broken by pandas' stable sort.

model_provenance.scorer: src/live/scorer.py — uses folds[-1]'s model + feature_names; reindex→fillna(0.0)→predict_proba[:,1]

caveats: TimesFM pretraining vintage: the checkpoint's cutoff is undocumented and may cover 2024-2025 macro/price patterns, so `timesfm_pred_return_1m` values on 2025+ holdout rows are a possible leak channel. Flagged, not remediable in Sprint 7.

18-month window has limited statistical power for Sharpe: 353 daily observations put the standard error on Sharpe at roughly ±0.30 (Bailey-López de Prado approximation) — the 1.016 point estimate is not statistically distinguishable from the 0.600 threshold at 95% confidence. The verdict is applied deterministically per the pre-committed rule, but the caveat matters for narrative claims.

Under-diversified holdings: mean 14.9 names vs the 20-name target on 13 of 18 months, driven by portfolio_builder's MIN_SCORE=0.52 gate combined with the sub-in-sample breadth of the frozen model. This amplifies month-to-month variance.

Monthly performance concentration: +49.3% total return is dominated by May 2026 (+28.7% single-month strategy return, +23.4% excess vs SPY). Removing that single month drops holdout total return to roughly +16% and would materially change the verdict distance.

Regime skew: 15/18 months RISK_ON (1.2× leverage) and only 1 RISK_OFF (2026-03-31) — leverage was on for the bulk of the window and materially inflates both realised return and drawdown vs the un-gated model.
CPI: backfilled 2026-01 → 2026-05 via scripts/backfill_cpi.py (Sprint 7 Prompt 3 Part A0); Apr-Jun 2026 rows use real CPI data. No ffill placeholder in the holdout window.
Universe: 54 tickers in universe.csv; portfolio_builder aligned to 52 tickers over the holdout window (2 dropped for missing prices).
verdict_notes: Holdout Sharpe = 1.0160 clears the pre-committed 0.600 threshold by +0.416. What drove it: (1) the frozen last-fold model kept generating usable rank information in 2025-26 despite the 18-month training gap, (2) a heavily RISK_ON regime (290/354 days at 1.2× leverage) amplified positive selection, and (3) a single anomalous month — May 2026 at +28.7% strategy vs +5.3% SPY — contributed roughly half the excess-return gap. The strategy's Sharpe advantage over SPY (Δ +0.009) is thin; the +23-pt total-return excess is what would show up in P&L. What this proves: the Sprint 5 factor stack + graded regime gate did not decay to noise on a genuine out-of-sample window. What it does NOT prove: statistical robustness — 18 months puts a ~±0.30 standard error on the Sharpe estimate, and any of the caveats (TimesFM data-vintage leak, May 2026 concentration, regime skew) is individually sufficient to explain the excess. Treat this as a green flag to enter Sprint 8's paper-trading phase, not as evidence of a validated edge.
